cpu_basis: Sum of CPU time deltas for harness and three WebKit helpers / elapsed time; 100% means one core fully busy
limitations: One machine; table uses one 20-second sample per mode/pose; an earlier local run showed different CPU values
Full means full mode of this branch, not a separately measured upstream binary
Fresh harness process per trial; file/OS caches are not cleared
Does not include production native polling, hooks, updater or quota features
GPU and Networking verified by cache bundle ID; WebContent paired by new process and type
Footprint sampled once at end; ps CPU time has limited precision
System background load was not controlled
notes: Final PR renderer remeasured; system caches and other application load were not controlled. Do not infer a fixed improvement percentage.
